content.text:
Working through the sheep problem:
- "All but 9 run away" leaves 9 sheep.
- He buys twice as many as remain, which is 18, so he has 27.
- He sells a third of the flock, which is 9, so he has **18 sheep**.

Now I'll get the weather for both cities.
